output.subject: Thank you for reporting a suspicious text message
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to call us and let us know about the text message you received. We appreciate you bringing it to our attention, and we have your report on record.

You told us that you received a text message claiming to be from Meridian Harbor Bank about an "unusual sign in," which included a link to a website. You mentioned that you did not click the link and did not share any information in response to the message. You were right to be cautious, and reports like yours are genuinely helpful to us.

A specialist team is now reviewing what you shared, and we will respond to you within 10 business days. If anything else comes up in the meantime, or if you receive any further messages like this one, please do let us know.

Thank you again for looking out for your account and for helping us.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a phishing report, not a complaint; the reply thanks the customer rather than addressing a grievance.
The call note says the representative reviewed the account and found no unusual activity. This was left out per acknowledge-only mode, so decide whether to tell the customer.
Decide whether to add the bank's approved guidance on recognizing and reporting fraudulent texts.
The phishing link was deliberately not repeated in the reply. Keep it out of the final version.
Confirm whether the customer expects any follow-up beyond acknowledgment, since the issue may already be resolved from their side.
